title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1982-08-08

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a scorching Alpine Valley ‘82 show with smoking “They Love Each Other,” tight Garcia/Phil work, and standout “Scarlet/Fire” and “Samson.”
ai_review.review: The recording is widely praised as a crisp, phenomenal sound‑board mix that lets every nuance of the band shine.  The performance itself is described as hot and tightly played, with Jerry’s bending guitar, Phil’s savage bass, and memorable moments like “They Love Each Other,” “Scarlet/Fire,” “Good Lovin’” and the fiery “Samson.”  Guest musicians add extra flavor but never detract from the overall high‑energy flow.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are 4–5 stars and consistently praise both the show’s energy and the soundboard quality, with no substantive criticisms.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix; praised as phenomenal engineering, very little noise despite a polite crowd, no reported drop‑outs or major flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Seamless second set (reviewers note you can splice CD2/1 for continuity), high‑energy flow with tight transitions and a strong jammed finale.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Tight playing, crisp guitar tone, noticeable string bends on “Promised Land,” and overall superb lead work.
band_member_comments.Phil: Savage, insane bass performance; one reviewer wished for even more bass presence.
band_member_comments.Bob: Earnest vocal delivery on “Good Lovin’” and solid rhythm support throughout.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland’s keyboards are present (some note a modest jam on his tune), generally solid and supportive.
band_member_comments.Drums: Guest percussionist Hamza El Din praised; overall rhythm section described as ‘overdrive’ and very powerful.
